title: Through the Fairness Lens: Experimental Analysis and Evaluation of Entity Matching

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating error rates (such as False Discovery Rate and True Positive Rate Parity) of entity matching models on a semi-synthetic no-fly list dataset (NoFlyCompas) containing African-American and Caucasian individuals.

Measuring disparity in matching performance and error rates of entity matchers on a dataset (FacultyMatch) of Chinese and German faculty members, evaluating the impact of group over-representation and name similarity.

Auditing entity matchers for performance disparities across various non-demographic subgroups, including music genres, publication venues, product brands, and sports batting styles, using multiple fairness measures like Positive Predictive Value Parity.
